gate:
Some codes work by smoothing things over. This one works the opposite way. It is the drive to poke at what has gone numb until it twitches back to life, a precise needling aimed at the one stuck point in a person or a room where spirit has been forgotten under the surface arrangement. The pull is not cruelty and not contrarianism for sport. It is a pressure in the body that wants to find the soft place in another's feeling and press on it until something gives.

Most people misread the drive as trouble-making, and the person carrying it sometimes misreads it that way too, especially when the timing is off and the press lands as nuisance. The true aim is mutative. When the provocation lands well, it is a small infectious spark that wakes a room into feeling. Misread, it reads as moodiness, picking fights, or stirring trouble to drain pressure off.
centre_field:
This drive is wired to the part of you that sits at the base of the body and pumps pressure upward through everything else you do. It is one of the engines of action, an adrenalised stress motor that pulses on and off rather than running steady. That placement is the teaching. The provocation is not a clever idea arriving from the head, it is a pulse arriving from the floor, on its own timing, pushing outward until it finds release.

When the pulse is up, the carrier prods and stirs and finds the soft spot in a room with uncanny accuracy. When the pulse is down, the same body sits in a moodiness that mistakes itself for personal failure or character flaw. Knowing where the impulse actually comes from, that it is a tide rather than a temperament, is half the work of carrying this code without turning it against yourself.
channel:
Provocation by itself is a finger in someone's ribs with no point being made. It pokes, it stirs, and there is no message inside the poke, only pressure looking for an exit. For the code to come alive, it has to reach for another part of you, the part that holds the felt knowing that spirit, not scarcity, is the actual source of supply.

The lineage calls this reach the channel of emoting, a wire that runs from the pressurised floor up into feeling. Joined, the prod becomes a teaching about where supply truly comes from, and the moodiness becomes a wave with information inside it. Without that other half, the stirring is just stirring. With it, the same drive becomes a way of waking people into a richer felt sense of life, an alarm clock built to need a morning to wake into.
